precedent_checks.content: VERIFIED 2026-10-12 (full PDF). Peng II tiles a big box by small boxes carrying standard maps (eq. 13, from Thm 3.1/Peng I). Sec. 3.3 (within a tile): counting root-class half planes shows the A' part of each standard map is affine and its linear part permutes R_G (Lemmas 3.3.1-3.3.3; Remark 3.3.1: scalar multiple of a finite-order element of O(n)). Sec. 4 'Aligning the linear part of standard maps': Thm 4.1 (horocycles go near horocycles over the big box) by EFW II-style H graphs, Gromov products and illegal-circuit loops (Lemma 4.2.5), with a rank-1 geodesic counting lemma (4.3.2) used to force divergence; Cor 4.0.1 then equalises linear parts by a measure-vs-length argument. Rank 1 'follows exactly the same proof as in [EFW2]'; higher rank 'consists of many rank 1 argument'. Sec. 5 'Patching' aligns translational parts by EFW I's multiscale tiling + 0-quadrilaterals. Previous snippet claims confirmed, except: (a) the rank>=2 argument is not a separate mechanism, it is built from EFW II rank-1 arguments; (b) 255 intro:43-47 ('compares them across boxes') is accurate but the comparison is coarse-topological, not volume-based.

final.justification: Eureka CANDIDATE only, weak. Full-text re-check (2026-10-12) of the decisive precedent, Peng II Sec. 4, shows a genuinely different mechanism for the same sub-problem: EFW II-style coarse topology (illegal-circuit loops, Gromov products, divergence of geodesics, 'many rank 1 argument'), followed by a measure-vs-length corollary (Cor 4.0.1). C1's device (co-location forces the facet reflection; opposite images double the exponent; alternating two-sheet bundles give target e^{2rP(E)} against source e^{rP(E)}) does not occur there, nor in EFW, Ferragut, DFX, Dymarz-Xie or growth/entropy literature. Non-analytic; load-bearing by knockout on every comparator target (7.2% of core as a cluster). Confidence raised 0.35 -> 0.40 only: (i) Peng Cor 4.0.1 shows a measure-based contradiction to cross-tile label mismatch is already in the literature, so only the specific doubling/alternation device is new; (ii) the gadget is the cross-sheet mirror of the paper's own anti-folding inequality I28 and an application of its P-comparison (I08/I14/I23), so test 4 may show it is easily found once P is given; (iii) no expert check. Conditional on correctness (Lean trusted as published).

verified_checks.finding: Peng II Sec. 4 solves the same sub-problem as C1 (linear parts of the tile-wise standard maps agree across tiles) by a genuinely different, coarse-topological mechanism inherited from EFW II. Thm 4.1 (images of root-class horocycles / W_b^+ cosets are close to horocycles over the whole big box) is proved with S, S-hat and H graphs of 'shadow vertices', the Gromov product rho_l in the negatively curved slice W_l^- x| R v_l, the 'illegal circuit' loop Lemma 4.2.5 (4- or 6-gon loops of E0 edges), a rank-1 geodesic-family counting Lemma 4.3.2 used only to force two geodesics to diverge (pigeonhole), Props 4.3.1-4.3.2 (unobstructed geodesics), and Thm 4.2, whose final step compares the linear parts at two points y0, y by two-sided Lemma 4.2.5 loop inequalities ('the loop that prevents blocking', Fig. 3). Cor 4.0.1 then gets equality of linear parts from Thm 4.1 by a short measure-vs-length argument: if root class [alpha] goes to [Xi] at x and to [beta] != [Xi] at y, pick a hyperplane P separating v_[beta] and v_[Xi]; the P-perpendicular geodesics joining the image horocycles have length O(diam B), but because the horocycle pieces xV_[alpha], yV_[alpha] have equal measure while their alpha_0 heights differ by Omega(eps diam B), most preimages must have length >= e^{eps diam B}. There is no facet-reflection structure (labels are arbitrary root-class permutations, any rank), no union of opposite images with exponent doubling P(E'_1 u E'_2) = 2P(E), no alternation of switch bundles between two sheets, and no source/target volume-exponent comparison across tiles. Volume/half-plane counting appears in Peng II only WITHIN a tile (Sec. 3.3: QI roughly preserves the number of root-class half planes; this gives affinity of the A' part and that the linear part permutes the root set R_G), which is the abelian precedent for 255's C3, C4 and I23, not for C1. Sec. 5 aligns translational parts by EFW I's procedure (multiscale tilings Omega_j = (1+s)^j Omega and 0-quadrilaterals), not by measure multipliers.
